answers.rationale: The requirement specifies switchgear with single doors placed as per the plan-view. CROWN-ARMV is suitable as it provides metal-clad switchgear with customizable configurations, including door placements.
The detailed door specifications, including keyed handles, weatherproof rear doors, and hazard signs, align with the customizable features of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
This requirement pertains to compliance with ANSI standards for hazard signs, which is a commercial or compliance matter, not a product specification.
The stationary structure for walk-through switchgear in a weatherproof steel housing matches the description of CROWN-EHOUSE, which provides pre-built electrical houses with switchgear compartments.
The requirement for a rigid metal-clad switchgear assembly aligns with the features of CROWN-ARMV, which is designed for metal-clad switchgear configurations.
The specification for welded sections housing circuit breakers is consistent with the construction standards of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
Grounded barriers and solid removable metal barriers for isolation are features of CROWN-ARMV, which provides robust metal-clad switchgear designs.
The structural fabrication details, including steel sheets and reinforced members, align with the construction standards of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
